annotations.annotation_text: Liturgical or ecclesiastical allusion (exodus): weaving Catholic ritual, Latin prayers, and sacramental language into the domestic nighttime dream.
sources: Frazer, Sir James George. Folk-Lore in the Old Testament. https://archive.org/details/folkloreinoldtes01frazuoft

annotations.annotation_text: The Twelve Jurors / Tavern Drinkers (bottle): representing the chorus of public opinion, the twelve signs of the Zodiac, the Apostles, and the customers gossiping in HCE's Chapelizod pub.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp
